_about: Tegucigalpa: title, focus area and baselines. Manifest paths are relative to this folder. To add a baseline, build it with tools/sheet_to_globe (output dir data/tegucigalpa) and add one entry to layers; show: false keeps a layer listed but off the page.
title: Tegucigalpa
intro: The valley as the surveyors drew it, laid back onto the globe. Slide through the years to watch the city grow, or switch to the satellite view.

layers.label: 1983 survey
layers.credit: 1983: Tegucigalpa and Lepaterique, 1:50,000 topographic series. Perry-Castañeda Library Map Collection, courtesy of the University of Texas Libraries, The University of Texas at Austin. Mosaic and georeferencing: Yanira A. Rivera.
